spec: No card. Two columns on the page grid, 32/40 quote at weight 500, tracking -2%, opening mark hung left of the text edge so the text stays on the grid. Name and role pinned to the base at 14px, customer logo right-aligned on that line. Pair one long quote with one four-word quote.

One quote as a full-width moment: 48 to 64px on 1.05 leading, tracking -2 to -3%, often the page's only serif, 700 to 1220px wide. Mark in the left rail or none. Attribution 14 to 18px below, with square portrait and logo split by a rule. Sits between hairlines or on a quiet field.

A short centred quote between feature blocks, no card: 20 to 28px, 580 to 820px wide, 36 to 48px avatar, 14px name and role, optional logo after a 1px divider. Emphasis by ink: first sentence full ink and the rest muted, or one phrase at weight 500. Stays below headings in weight.

A quote that carries its own numbers. Quote 20 to 60px, then under a hairline two or three figures at 24 to 48px with 12 to 15px labels, or one mono proof point right-aligned. 40 to 64px avatar, logo and story link. Figures must come from the quoted customer.

Two to four cards or a rail, radius 6 to 32, padding 24 to 40, gap 16 to 24. Customer logo top left as the headline, 16 to 20px quote, then 36 to 48px avatar, 14px name and grey role pinned to the base with margin-top:auto. Make one card much shorter than the others.

Text cards where the person is the hook: radius 0 to 24, padding 24 to 40, 15 to 26px quote at the top, two or three line attribution pinned to the base, empty space between. No logo needed. For health, name the theme instead of the person. Hang the opening mark.

Three to five customer logos as tabs above one story. Each tab is a 2px grey rule over a grey logo; the active logo takes brand colour and its rule fills as a 6 to 8s timer. Below: 24 to 36px quote, divider, one big figure or portrait. Pause on hover, stop under reduced motion.

Two columns: 520 to 680px media beside a 28 to 40px quote with hung mark. Media is a candid photo, a duotone portrait, or a grainy plate in the customer's colour with a centred white logo. Avatar and name low; 40px arrows and a story link aligned to the media's base.

One or two panels of loud colour on a quiet page: radius 8 to 40, 400 to 800px tall, 24 to 36px quote with tight leading top left, name and logo pinned low. Unequal widths such as 880 and 432 beat equal ones. Text in a dark tint of the fill. Use once.

Three to five columns 250 to 440px, gap 16 to 22, heights set by real content. Cards radius 8 to 20, 1px pale border, padding 24 to 32, 36 to 48px avatar, 14/600 name, 13px handle or source, 15 to 17px text. Mask the bottom into a 36px Show more pill. Vary lengths threefold.

Two rows of 320 to 350px cards offset half a card, drifting at different speeds, edges masked over 90px. Radius 16 to 30, 1px border, 40px logo tile, 14px name, 14 to 20px quote. One key sentence bold on a highlighter using box-decoration-break:clone. Pause on hover, static under reduced motion.

Cards 320 to 1060px bleed off the right edge, the next one visibly cut as the scroll cue, gap 16 to 24. Heading or rating block fixed at left or above, 36 to 44px arrows or a progress line, scroll-snap on. Best with few substantial quotes. Never autoplay.

The photo is the card. 276 to 690px wide, radius 8 to 32: a portrait with a darkened lower half and 16 to 28px white quote over it, or a photo flush on top with the quote in a tinted body below. The photo must show the real person or the real job.

Masonry of unequal tiles, radius 12 to 32, gap 16 to 32. Portraits with scrim quotes alternate with cream tiles holding award marks and press mastheads, or a tall product photo sits between review columns. Four columns of 288px or two of 495px. The kinds of proof vary, the tile recipe does not.

People talking. Three 375px portrait cards, radius 4 to 20, 22px outcome sentence over a bottom gradient, 64px play ring. Or a wall of 217px talking heads at 4 to 8px gaps beside a 72px count, a name pill on each clip. Captions on, sound off by default.

Third parties, not customers. Score or quote first, outlet as the mark: 332 by 294 outlined cards with a 35px score top left, white publisher logo top right, 19px quote low. Or 14px one-liners under grey mastheads. Keep each outlet's letterforms and link to the article.

Reviews as a public record. Rating row above with score, stars, count and See all, then three columns: star row, 16 to 22px title, 14 to 16px text, tracked name, italic date, no cards or one tint. Keep dates and one mixed review. Best for stores and local services.

Quotes set straight on the page in two to six columns, no cards, only 1px rules at most. 16 to 20px text, justified serif or ragged sans, dash attribution in 15/500 sans, or ruled cells at 40px padding. About 100px of air under a small label and a heavy rule.

The quote takes the shape of speech: a 640px white bubble, radius 28, small tail pointing at a 44px portrait. Or scattered capsules, radius 60, 20px text, two small circles trailing to a round avatar on a soft glow. Short informal lines only, off-grid on purpose.

One person at length. A 766px square paper card with 48px avatar, ruled heading, 16/28 candid bullets and a signature. Or a full-screen question and answer split by 1px rules, one exchange per viewport. Use when you have a real voice and no logos.

Rules above and below. Left column: 14px bold label and one small drawing in the accent colour. Right: 28px regular quote in a five-column measure, then a link. One witty mark replaces avatars, stars and logos.

Testimonials as a client list. Full-width 108px rows on 1px rules: 15px caps project left, 60px radius-8 greyscale portrait with caps name and grey title centred, 56px pale disc with accent plus right. Hover tints the row and blackens the disc; opening reveals the quote.

A review shares a row with something the reader can do: two 546 by 600 cards, 8px gap, radius 24, one a 44px question with 54px pill answers, the other stars, 44/48 quote and a member chip. Proof sits one tap from the decision. Keep legal disclosures visible.

One drifting row of marks flattened to one mid grey, 24 to 32px tall, 56 to 100px gaps, in a 960 to 1320px window with 10 to 12% mask fades at both ends. 12 to 15px caption above or none. 40 to 60s loop, pause on hover, static under reduced motion.

Two rows drifting opposite ways, offset half a logo, in a 190 to 300px band. Raw black or full-colour marks 24 to 60px tall, or cells with 1px rules and a 36px caption strip carrying the count between the rows. Use when the list is long and heavy.

Static row or 6 by 2 grid, marks flattened to one grey near 45 to 60% ink, about 24px optical height, 170 to 196px column pitch, 58 to 107px row pitch, no boxes. 13 to 15px muted caption or none. Deliberately quiet so neighbours keep the attention.

Marks in solid ink or pure white, 24 to 32px tall, no greying: six justified along the hero's base, 6 by 2 at 170px pitch, or a tight 4 by 2 cluster 575px wide in a void. No caption. Confidence comes from strength and the space around.

Marks keep brand colour, 22 to 40px tall, each centred in a drawn page column or between two hairlines: a 72px band under the hero, or 4 by 2 at 100px row pitch. No caption, no boxes. Logo colour is the section's only decoration.

Logos in cells of a shared 1px table, no gaps: 5 by 4 at 275 by 129, or one 66px strip of six cells with a 14px label in the first. Mono marks 24 to 28px tall, centred. A serif phrase may replace the caption. Hover draws a 2px accent bottom edge.

A ruled wall that navigates. Five or six columns, cells 97 to 129px tall, logos at full ink, a small corner arrow on about half the cells, marking those with a written story. Hover tints the cell. A last tile may hold a portrait and one figure.

Each mark in a filled tile: 172 to 291px wide, 64 to 124px tall, gaps 2 to 16, radius 0 to 12, one tone off the page, black mono logos. Tiles give weak logos equal presence. Scatter two accent tints, or run as a marquee at 8px gaps with edge fades.

A grey wall or marquee at 35% ink with exactly one mark in full colour or white, changing on a timer or lit as it passes centre. The small movement proves someone cared. 5 by 6 at 222 by 104, or a 40px masked row.

Marks that do something. Grey wordmarks at 40% with one at full strength and a 2px underline filling as a story timer; or insurers as choices under a price line; or client names in 32px pills that open the work.

No band. Five 20 to 24px grey marks in the text column under the sentence they support, at 86px centres; or a 94px strip on the hero's foot; or a 450 by 56 dock; or marks passing behind the headline. Proof attaches to a claim.

Three to five marks, large and alone: 230px pitch inside a 420px radius-32 panel, 150px press marks on a black band, or black 40px wordmarks on a flat 217px colour band cut by the viewport. A few logos in a lot of room outrank a long strip.

Publications in their own letterforms, one ink, 28 to 34px tall, about 100px gaps or small diamonds between, 12 to 16px AS SEEN IN label. On paper bands the ink takes the page's tone. If it drifts add a visible pause control. Only real coverage.

Recognition as objects: 56 to 120px medals or laurels in two centred rows at 80px pitch, or 70px marks with 16px captions, no boxes. Third-party colour stays, or redraw as grey wreaths with award and year inside. A 52px ledger works for portfolios.

Trust as plain facts: three 106px hairline seals with the label over a faint engraved icon, five 103px ruled cells with 32px line icons above the footer, or 36px chips stating status in words, such as expected Q1 2027. Redraw as one family; never paste vendor badges.

Client names as type, no logos. Three rows of 51px serif at 120px height on 1px rules, 18px hollow circles between, rows sliding opposite ways. Or an alphabetical 14px list in one 480px column, where a gallery and a global brand weigh the same.

Customers shown as your product's own object: a row of 40px app icons with soft shadows, or 240 by 56 org cards with 32px logo, name, plan pill and truncated stats. Reuse the real component. Colour stays because each item is a thing.

Cell size encodes tier: 3-up at 180px, then 5-up at 88px, 12px mono tier label per row, shared 1px rules, marks at 70% ink. Leave unfilled cells empty and end with a faint Become a sponsor cell. Honest for open source and events.

Logos with a number attached: a ruled 120px row with a fixed cell holding a score out of 5 beside a drifting logo cell, or grey marks each above tan stars with a 12px underlined disclosure. Name the source and the date.

The list gets one small idea: a two-column Colourful and Sleek table with a swap button, a drawn beam landing on each logo in turn, or black marks on a painted panel. Only when the brand already jokes. Logos stay fully legible.

Three or four left-aligned columns on the page grid, no cards or rules. Numeral 32 to 56px at 400 to 600, tracking -3 to -6%, tabular figures, 12px gap, 14 to 16px label. About 200px of clear space above. Accent colour only if numerals are few.

Three or four columns under 1px rules: each column its own top rule with 16 to 48px gaps, or one pair of full-width hairlines around the row with 120px padding. Numerals 47 to 96px at 300 to 600, 16px two-line caption. A short accent segment can ride the hairline to mark focus.

Three to five cells sharing 1px rules, rail to rail, about 180px tall, 40px top padding, 16px side padding. Numerals 48 to 64px with -4% tracking at a weight that survives your face, 16px caption, optional mono index or dagger footnote. Stacks unchanged on phones.

Stats as stacked rows. Right 600px column beside a 40px two-tone heading, rows 160px tall on 1px hairlines: 64/400 figure left, right-aligned 16px label over a 12px mono caps note. Or alternate figure, customer logo and one sentence on a dark band.

Each number names whose it is. Three 275px columns under a 1px rule: logo, 42px numeral, 15px descriptor, grey Read the story. Or rows of 24px logo, bold figure and grey rest of phrase at 56px pitch. Or tiles in each customer's colour.

Three or four filled tiles, radius 0 to 12, gap 4 to 20, padding 24 to 36: numeral 44 to 64px, a 20px subject, a 13px explanation. One tone off the page, or near-black on light. Set the disclosure under the row, in plain 13px text.

Cards stepped so the ground shows through: 416 by 162 at radius 32 with the second column 64px lower, or outlined radius-2 cards descending left to right with mono numerals and a live counter. Place beside a photo or falling art, not in a row.

Full-bleed flat band in a deep brand colour, 32px heading, three or four 48 to 96px white numerals, 14 to 24px tinted captions, 64 to 120px padding, no cards. Superscript units at half size. Use once, as the page's one flood.

The figure is drawn, not stated: widths in true ratio (170 beside 988px for 45 and 220 wpm), bars proportional on the page grid, a dot matrix spelling the count, circles counted and crossed, or one hairline curve under 2px-ticked metrics. The scale must be honest.

Reproducible comparison. 3 by 2 cards, 1px rule, 16px gap, 20px padding: 16px title, 13px scenario, four mono race rows with bars and yours in bold, a rule, then accent multiplier and memory figure. Method note and reproduce link below. Bars to scale.

Numbers read as sentences. Centred 64/600 lines at 88px pitch: figure, an inline object at cap height replacing the word space, noun. Or 24px facts split by a rule, or bold figures opening ordinary lines beside a phone. No labels, no cards.

One figure owns the section: 96 to 200px, tight, alone in a band or outlined card, 13 to 14px caption. It may roll on entry or change with scroll. Choose the one number that would surprise someone, and never rest on zero.

White numerals 40 to 130px directly on a photo, 12 to 14px tracked label, darkening only where they sit. Inset the pane 100px or use the photo's dark area. Or small white chips at radius 10 on a close-up. The photo must relate to the number.

A number that is visibly running: tabular 36 to 56px digits, comma-grouped, ticking or rolling, 12px label, small map or filter beside it. State the source and when it last reset. Needs a real feed; otherwise use a dated static figure.

A thin band of facts, not figures: 80px tall, flat tint or graph paper, three 24px/500 statements each led by a 24 to 32px glyph, split by 32px rules. Or 64px custom line icons with 21px labels. Mix numbers and words. Suits stores and local firms.

Scores from named platforms: three units 40px apart with a 32px numeral, five 14px stars and a 13px source. Or tiles, or wreaths around press logos on a quiet 248px band with a 12px disclosure. Real sources only.

Stats that get no section: inside the hero or CTA row, 16 to 24px value over a 14px muted label, about 40px apart or split by 1px rules 58px tall. Or 32px pills under the subhead. Baseline-matched to the button.

Wide quote cells alternate with narrow metric cells: 1px border, one corner colour wash, 30px display text, mono caps label, logo at base. Or one card of stacked figures beside a 2 by 2 analyst grid on a darker ground.

A table of customers. Rows 56 to 120px, on a 1px rule or none at 96px pitch: 14px name, one-line result, grey logo, 11px mono caps tag, right-aligned READ STORY. Hover fills the row, inset 8px from the page. Finish with a Your company row.

Three or four columns, no borders: a 4:3 or 16:10 tile in a pale tone, flat brand colour or greyscale still with a large centred logo, then 14 to 18px title and a mono tag or Read story link below the tile. Gutters 16 to 24, radius 4.

Three 400 by 480 tiles or a rail of 332 by 430, radius 0 to 6, each with custom art in that customer's palette, big centred logo, small wordmark bottom left. Below: 16/22 two-line result and accent link. Art must be art; a bare gradient reads as missing.

Four 80px logo cells as tabs, active cell shaded. Below, 50/50: left bottom-aligned caps label and a 32px two-tone metric headline, right a photo bleeding to the rails. Or half stat, half photo. One customer on screen at a time.

One open, the rest collapsed: a 752 by 340 gradient card beside 76px logo strips, or an open row with halftone photo and white stat pills over 80px closed rows with 48px logo tile and 24px headline. Transition width over 400ms.

One card, radius 12, 1392 by 470, split 60/40. Left a full-bleed still quiet enough for a co-brand lockup, 56px play disc, mono WATCH label. Right white: logo, 34 to 36px tight quote, 16px name, 12px mono role, two buttons pinned low.

Mixed cells at 2 to 16px gaps, radius 0 to 24. White cells on a deep ground: 64px stat over a rule, caption, logo foot, beside a wide quote cell with inset portrait and stacked name tags. Or a neon quote block beside a logo tile. Two cell recipes at most.

One image edge to edge, 740px or viewport tall, no radius, breaking the page margins. White caption bottom left at 32px inset: 15/500 name over 15px mono type. No scrim. Or fade the bottom third into the page and set logo and statement on the fade.

Darkened customer photo tiles, 310 to 575px, radius 0 to 12, tinted 30 to 40%, large white logo, 24px result line, small glass button. Or black 360 by 460 cards where a photo fades in on hover behind the same logo.

One story per page with controls you can count: a 416px copy column beside an 848 by 477 image, mono 01 / 05 between 28px arrows, copy crossfading. Or a centre slide 578px wide with cropped neighbours. Never autoplay without a pause.

Result first, no photo: 404 by 372 white cards, radius 16, 8px gap, bleeding both edges on a grey ground, 56px grey logo tile, 24/39 outcome line, 14px client at base, heading below the rail. Or a screenshot in a cream well above tags.

Agency index. Two to four columns, 12 to 16px gutters, media-led, radius 0 to 24, mixed aspect ratios so rows interlock, 12 to 14px title and grey tag beneath, no card chrome. Filter pills 24 to 32px above, active filled.

The story as text. A sticky label column (Challenge, Solution, Products) at 13 to 15px beside a product fragment on a tint, or three ruled columns with the finding in bold and a link to the source. Substance replaces imagery.

The customer's real product in a scene: a 418px live site floating on a 558px photo card, a dark app window cropped in a 720px colour block that checkers with the next case, or a bordered browser card beside a plain heading.
Three or four 1px cards, radius 0, 204px video with 56px play disc and name on a scrim, mono company, 20px headline stating one fact, 14px copy, CTA pinned low. Talks from real events work best.

Four to six columns of greyscale portraits, 4:5 or square, radius 0 to 4, gutters 8 to 68. Name 13 to 15px at 400 or 500, role 11 to 14px grey. Same head size and light across the set. Group by office under 32px titles.

Different people cut onto one ground: 170 to 320px portraits, radius 0 to 24, a single warm or neutral backdrop, 14 to 18px name, muted credentials. Separate headshots read as one shoot, even when taken years apart.
Each person on a flat colour: pastels in 5-column white cards, saturated tiles with a white name strip, or a gradient strip with no gaps. Pick from three or four fills. Cut-outs need clean edges.

A tall tile as the card: 370px dark tile, radius 20 to 32, cut-out rising from the base, translucent 56px label inset 8px with 18px name and 15px role. Or a photo above two 42px pills for role and LinkedIn.

People as qualifications. 300 by 170 gradient cards with cut-out doctor, title and specialties on a 2px rule, or a 282 by 353 rail with a verified mark. Name 16 to 18px with degrees, role and institution stated. Short bio below the card.

Many people, small. Three columns at 408px pitch, rows 153px: 96px square portrait radius 8, 18px name, 14px grey role, 20px social glyphs and a flag. Or gutter ticks with name, affiliation and pill. End with a Could be you tile.
Everyone else as text: four columns at 336px pitch, 16px grey names on 39px lines under the portraits, no photos. Or 13px associates, or mono label and value rows. Scales to hundreds without effort.

One named person as the pitch. 50/50: a 676 by 1000 greyscale portrait cropped to the waist beside a bio in the page's display serif at 63/68, link pinned to the photo's base. Or a 56px greeting on ink beside an offset-framed portrait.

Real people in a real place: two 670 by 376 snapshots, 34px gutter, no radius, 13px caps caption naming everyone in frame. Or a staff photo in a 16px frame beside a contact trio. Imperfect light is a feature.

Volume as proof. 100 greyscale 36 to 60px avatars in a perspective wall or rows fading at the edges, one turning full colour with a mono name tag, one line above stating the true count. Real contributors only.

Portraits in one commissioned hand: black-line busts on a 1px rule with skin as the only fill, hatched circles on a dotted bus line, or depth-of-field overlap with the focused face sharp. The treatment is the signature.
Backers, small and quiet: two flat 140px tiles with firm marks and 11px partner names, or a row of 32px portraits with name and firm captions under a 48px Backed by line. Sits after the team.
No team grid at all. Three full-width 48px rows on 1px rules: 14px grey label left, 14/500 link with arrow right. A question, a next step and a jobs link replace faces.

A catalogue. Ruled 1248px grid, 32px padding, mono caps category, logos 26px tall in wrapping rows, last item a grey mono + Any SAML / OIDC. Or three columns of 65px rows: 20px line icon, 14px name, 14px grey descriptor. Brand colour stays.

Your product as the hub. A 96px dark tile centred in a tinted panel at radius 28, 48px white icon tiles stacked 5 left and 6 right, 1.5px grey beziers landing on the hub at slightly different heights. A hairline, then three named one-liners.

Four to six columns of 183 by 124 tiles, gaps 8 to 16, radius 0 to 8, pale fill, 40 to 44px logo over 15/600 label. Final tile is an ellipsis meaning any tool. Text link centred below, pill toggle above if there are modes.

Scannable directory. Three columns of 44px tiles, 1px border, radius 8, 16px gap, 20px colour logo, 15px grey name, last tile View all. Or 40px icon tile and 16px label at 68px pitch, with a 21+ more pill below.

Icons in a row that dissolves. 64 to 96px square tiles, dark or translucent, radius 2 to 20, white or colour glyphs, 128px pitch or two offset rows, masked at the ends so the list feels unending. Copy holds the opposite side.

Tokens on rings: four concentric 1px rings cropped by a 384px card, 48px round logo tokens on them, brand mark centred. Or 72px white discs drifting at varied heights behind a heading, with a 64px search pill as the real action.

Two edge-bleeding rows offset half a card: 260 by 142 white cards, 1px border, radius 8, 48px icon tile, mono tag top right, 11px mono type label, 20px name. Hovered card tints. Shows a catalogue with real contents.

36px pills, soft fill, 16px glyph, 15/500 label, 8px gaps, wrapping under the subhead. Unavailable items sit at 50% opacity, so the row also states status. Or centred white pills fading at the last row to imply more.

Marks only, one ink: seven 48px solid framework marks on a 124px pitch beside copy, or a 6 by 3 grid of 40px grey connector logos in the right half. No tiles, no labels. Works when the audience already knows the marks.
A real repository as proof: a 57px row between hairlines with GitHub mark, 16/500 repo name, then language dot, star icon, count and arrow in 14px grey. Styled as table data, fetched live.
